title: Hourly throughput failure — 2026-06-12 17:00 UTC
description:
## Hourly throughput failure — 2026-06-12 17:00–18:00 UTC

**Verdict: FAIL** — net products added in canonical PostgreSQL (maglev) was **below the 150,000/hr threshold** for the 17:00–18:00Z hour.

### DB-proof numbers (from pg_stat_user_tables on maglev.proxy.rlwy.net:31310/railway)

| Signal | Value |
|---|---|
| Open anchor (S1, 2026-06-12T17:06:30Z) | `n_tup_ins = 49,046,566` |
| Close anchor (S2, 2026-06-12T18:04:23Z) | `n_tup_ins = 49,187,348` |
| Confirm sample (S3, 2026-06-12T18:06:16Z) | `n_tup_ins = 49,194,342` |
| Delta (S3 − S1) over 59m46s | **147,776 rows** |
| Interval | 59m46s = 0.9961h |
| Rate | **148,358 rows/hr** |
| Threshold | 150,000 rows/hr |
| % of target | **98.9%** (1,642 rows/hr short) |
| `n_live_tup` (S3) | 80,419,436 |
| `pg_postmaster_start_time` | 2026-06-08T10:21:09Z (4d7h ago, no restart in window → n_tup_ins delta method valid) |

### Secondary read (last 113s, S2→S3)

| Window | Delta | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 18:04:23Z → 18:06:16Z (113s) | 6,994 rows | ~222,840 rows/hr |

The rate **spiked in the final ~2 min** of the window (from ~146K/hr cumulative to ~223K/hr instantaneous), but the **weighted average across the full 59m46s window is still below 150K/hr** — narrowly under the bar. Hour fails.

### Prior hour context

| Hour (UTC) | Rate | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 14:00–15:00 | 326,360 rows/hr | BUY-44041 PASS |
| 15:00–16:00 | (MISSED — dispatcher cron broken, BUY-33694) | n/a |
| 16:00–17:00 | 285,136 rows/hr | BUY-44277 PASS (190.1% of target) |
| **17:00–18:00** | **148,358 rows/hr** | **this issue — FAIL (98.9% of target)** |

### Method

- Source: `pg_stat_user_tables.n_tup_ins` delta between two anchor samples (canonical per BUY-33694; hour-bucket `COUNT(*)` skipped — maglev contention causes timeout).
- `n_tup_ins` is the PRIMARY signal under maglev contention (per BUY-33694 dispatcher). It includes `INSERT` rows from all sources (rejects roundhouse by DB binding).
- No maglev restart in window (pm_start = 2026-06-08T10:21:09Z, 4d7h pre-window). Delta method valid.

### Operational notes

- The 17:00–18:00Z hour narrowly missed 150K/hr (1,642 rows/hr short). This is the second sub-bar hour in the last 24h (after the 15:00–16:00Z MISSED that was lost to the broken cron).
- The 16:00–17:00Z hour was strong (285K/hr). The slowdown in 17:00–18:00Z is consistent with the maglev DDL/Ops-stabilization period.
- Last maglev restart: 2026-06-08T10:21:09Z (BUY-35444 3rd restart). Fleet keep-alive is healthy per routine 476009cc (last clean tick 16:22Z, BUY-39634).

### Action requested

Owner: **Rich** (user `MRfjkCUzuFyLTtKHcVLDaJxoAAWxM7b6`).

1. Decide whether the 1,642 rows/hr shortfall is acceptable for this hour (narrow miss — fleet may have transiently paused lanes 17:00–18:00Z).
2. If not acceptable: investigate which lanes under-performed in 17:00–18:00Z and whether this signals the maglev catalog is hitting a structural cap.
3. Reference: dispatcher cron is still broken (BUY-33694); manual heartbeats via BUY-29861 children (this issue) are the active fallback check.

— Oracle (3ec8f6dd), heartbeat for 2026-06-12 18:00:00Z
